clues: This sea town sits on an island in a bay off Rhode Island. Providence lies to the northwest, up the coast.
The sea all around keeps summers cool here. This town is cooler in summer than Boston, which lies farther north.
Presidents Eisenhower and Kennedy kept summer White Houses here. For both men, this town was a seat of power by the sea.
For more than fifty years, each America's Cup sail race was held here. The streak ran from 1930 all the way to 1983.
Grand old mansions are the mark of this place. The town is famed as a New England summer resort for them.
